prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a NEW custom Chinese title logotype as an independent transparent lettering asset for an original anime game. It must read EXACTLY eight simplified Chinese characters, in two tiers:
Small top prefix: 升格会的
Large main title beneath: 冬日猜想

The essential design is HIERARCHY AND CONTRAST. Do not make all eight characters from one uniform typeface or one uniform colour.
1. “升格会的”: about half the height of the main title, a compact narrow deliberately angular hand-cut lettering style, precise upright strokes, restrained cobalt blue #4F77B8 with a thin pale edge. Treat this as the quiet organisation/intro line. It occupies roughly the left two-thirds of the main title's width. The 的 can be smaller but must be readable.
2. “冬日”: very large snow-white/ivory #EEF3F7 lettering, with flat icy-blue side facets. Custom elegant brush calligraphy with real thick-to-thin stroke contrast, a bold sweeping 冬 and a more compact structured 日. Crisp and confident, not rounded bubble letters.
3. “猜想”: equally large warm champagne-gold #E0C27B with a few brighter flat cream facets; same artistic calligraphic family as 冬日 but differentiated individual silhouettes. 猜 is slightly narrower and more upright; 想 is broader and finishes in a graceful curved 心 stroke, anchoring the right side. Keep every component of 猜 and 想 correct and clearly legible.

The four main characters make one satisfying close-knit silhouette, with chosen variations in height, width, baseline and stroke direction. Compose them as an expert game-brand type designer would, not a row of four identical font boxes. Subtle lively slant, measured negative spaces, readable counters, economical broad painted shapes, small crisp pointed terminals. The smaller blue prefix and the white/gold main title must form a single coherent lockup, noticeably sophisticated and beautiful at only 280 px wide.

Flat hand-painted graphic lettering, opaque clean coverage, slight human brush character, hard-edged broad highlights. Cool winter mystery with a restrained warm imaginative accent. Avoid candy-coloured noise, plastic gel text, 3D extrusion, metallic bevels, huge outlines, blurred halos, gradients, fake calligraphy nonsense, oversized decorative flourishes, stencils or plain typeset text.

Only the Chinese lettering itself. Do NOT include English, stars, ornaments, icons, frames, snowfall, scenery, mockups or people, because English and decoration are separate layers. No extra characters or duplicated words. Front-facing, tightly centered on actual transparent alpha with 5–8 percent clean transparent margins. A wide two-tier mark, main title roughly twice the prefix's height. Clean transparent background including inside all letter counters, no checkerboard, no shadow, no scattered particles or specks.
